The marches were also organised in several other districts of Karnataka, although some were cancelled or postponed due to permission-related …

candidates.title: Israel to close all land crossings with West Bank on election day
candidates.excerpt: The Israeli Army said that, from Sunday (October 25), Palestinians would "not be permitted to enter Israeli communities in Judea and Samaria and the Jordan Valley for work", using terms many in Israel use to refer to the West Bank

candidates.title: Police hold flag march in Narasaraopet ahead of local body polls
candidates.excerpt: The police urge everyone to strictly adhere to the MCC and refrain from activities that can disturb public peace and order

candidates.title: Military ups death toll in Mali attack to 54
candidates.excerpt: The armed forces said that the victims were buried on site and that nine survivors were evacuated to the city of Menaka

candidates.title: Manipur to form committee representing all 36 communities for unity: Yumnam Khemchand
candidates.excerpt: The Chief Minister said the proposal follows a query from Prime Minister Narendra Modi on whether such a committee existed to bring all communities together

candidates.title: Fact Check: Indian Army crackdown on CJP, 2 dead? No, find the truth about the video here
candidates.excerpt: A video is circulating on social media platforms with claims that it shows the Indian Army cracking down on CJP protesters, which led to the deaths of two people.

candidates.title: UN Must Show Leadership, Not Be Spectator to Global Crises: Jaishankar
candidates.excerpt: External Affairs Minister calls for reformed multilateralism, urging the UN to address its shortcomings and ensure wider representation in global decision-making

candidates.title: Violence, Tear Gas, Arrests: Europe Gripped By Growing Protests
candidates.excerpt: French police arrested nearly 1,000 people across the country as officers faced what Interior Minister Laurent Nunez described as an "extremely elevated level of violence" from black-clad extremists.

candidates.title: AIMIM fields 21 candidates in Andhra Pradesh civic polls, eyes key posts
candidates.excerpt: AIMIM has fielded 21 candidates in Andhra Pradesh's civic polls, targeting leadership positions in Kadapa and Hindupur. The party has deployed legislators and senior leaders to strengthen its campaign and expand its political presence beyond traditional strongholds before Assembly elections

candidates.title: 'War or no war, our policies remain unchanged': Iran FM Araghchi amid fresh US strike fears
candidates.excerpt: Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araghchi stated that Tehran's policies will not change regardless of potential war. He warned that resuming conflict would alter the security landscape in the Strait of Hormuz significantly. Following recent comments from US President Donald Trump, fears of renewed military action against Iran are escalating. Araghchi emphasized the need for rationality to avoid another military confrontation.

candidates.title: 'Nitish Kumar Is Gone, So Is JDU': MLA Anant Singh After Expulsion
candidates.excerpt: The JD(U) has expelled Mokama MLA Anant Singh and his wife, former MLA Neelam Devi, from the party for six years over alleged anti-party activities during the recent Bihar Legislative Council elections.

candidates.title: Bodies left to decompose at Jadcherla hospital mortuary, Laxma Reddy slams government
candidates.excerpt: Former Telangana Health Minister C Laxma Reddy criticised the Congress government over alleged decomposition of bodies at Jadcherla Government Hospital’s mortuary, blaming power disruptions and administrative negligence. He demanded uninterrupted electricity, immediate corrective measures and improvements in hospital infrastructure

candidates.title: PM Modi arrives in Kashi, to attend Air Force Day show along with Defence Minister
candidates.excerpt: Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived in Varanasi to attend the Indian Air Force’s 94th anniversary aerial display. He inaugurated an Arvind Limited garment manufacturing unit expected to boost employment, particularly for women, and strengthen Uttar Pradesh’s textile industry
